spell.jjk_spells.malevolent_shrine.guide: An open domain with no barrier. Darkness falls over the field while everything within range is struck by endless Dismantle and Cleave slashes, bleeds, and is hunted by Blood Slashes.
spell.jjk_spells.fuga.guide: Kai. A bow of flame and a colossal arrow take shape, are drawn, and loosed. Where the arrow lands the world is torn open by a fire explosion that levels the terrain and leaves the ground burning.
item.jjk_spells.king_of_curses_grimoire: Grimoire of the King of Curses
spell.jjk_spells.hollow_purple.guide: Lapse: Blue. Reversal: Red. Two opposing forces collide and merge into an imaginary mass that erases everything in its path. The orb grows with spell level.
spell.jjk_spells.lapse_blue.guide: Condense cursed energy into a swirling blue orb a short distance ahead. It drags nearby creatures toward its core and grinds them down with small, repeated damage. Higher levels enlarge the orb, widen its pull and hit harder.
spell.jjk_spells.reversal_red.guide: Launch a glowing red orb of repulsion. On impact it detonates, hurling everything nearby away from the blast and dealing explosive damage. Higher levels deal more damage and enlarge the explosion.
death.attack.jjk_spells.reversal_red: %1$s was blasted away by %2$s's Reversal: Red
spell.jjk_spells.unlimited_void.guide: The caster's hands seal, the sky pours in, and a starry black dome opens. Every enemy caught inside is Overloaded: unable to move, turn, attack, cast or heal for as long as the domain stands. The caster is immune.
spell.jjk_spells.simple_domain.guide: A thin circle drawn around the caster. For ten seconds the caster, and allies standing inside it, cannot be afflicted by Overload.
spell.jjk_spells.hollow_purple_nine_rope: "Nine Ropes. Polarized Light. Crow and Declaration. Between Front and Back." The caster floats, helpless, while Red and Blue circle him and merge behind him into one colossal Purple that detonates and erases the land around it. The caster loses 10% of his maximum health for 17 seconds.
spell.jjk_spells.world_cutting_slash.gui: "Scales of the Dragon. Repulsion. Paired Falling Stars." Scales of cursed energy spread across the ground, a repulsive pulse pushes everything back and two stars fall. Then the world itself is cut along a great grid, splitting the land into slabs and cutting through everything, armor included.
spell.jjk_spells.crimson_wrath: The Ruler of Death's Crimson Wrath
spell.jjk_spells.crimson_wrath.guide: Chant "Death is mine to command". Countless crimson eyes open in the sky, a vast red-and-black circle forms where you aim (up to 100 blocks), and red lasers rain on its centre for 8 seconds, wiping out everything inside.
spell.jjk_spells.time_stop.guide: Stand still and chant "Time is mine to control" atop a vast golden clock circle. The world flashes in negative, then time stops: everything except you freezes, and the colour drains from the world. Damage you deal while time is stopped is held back and lands all at once when time resumes. Level 1 stops time for 4 seconds, level 5 for 10.
spell.jjk_spells.storm_lords_wrath.guide: Summon two colossal black storm tornados that circle you for 12 seconds. Anything that touches either storm, or comes close to you, is battered for 80 damage per second and whirled into the air.
death.attack.jjk_spells.storm_lords_wrat: %1$s was torn apart by %2$s's Storm Lord's Wrath
spell.jjk_spells.gale_barrage.guide: Instantly unleash a flurry of rapid sword strikes in front of you: 27 hits over 4 seconds, each dealing 70% of your main-hand weapon's damage, wrapped in slashes of light and rushing wind.
spell.jjk_spells.gale_barrage.need_weapo: Hold a weapon in your main hand
death.attack.jjk_spells.gale_barrage: %1$s was cut down by %2$s's Gale Barrage
spell.jjk_spells.azure_colossus.guide: Summon a 25-block-tall guardian of blue chakra fire. While it stands, you and it are bonded: you take 85% less damage from every source. It fights beside you with a sword slash, volleys of blue-fire orbs and a ground-smashing shockwave. If it falls or fades, the bond ends.
spell.jjk_spells.azure_orb_barrage.guide: Hurl volleys of spinning blue-fire discs from both hands. Each disc detonates in a huge blue fire explosion that strips 5% of the maximum health of everything caught in it. Higher levels throw more volleys and widen the blast.
death.attack.jjk_spells.azure_colossus: %1$s was cut down by %2$s's Azure Colossus
death.attack.jjk_spells.azure_orb_barrag: %1$s was engulfed in blue fire by %2$s's Azure Orb Barrage
spell.jjk_spells.punch_barrage.guide: Hold to unleash a rapid flurry of punches at whatever you are facing, ten a second. Every punch deals the same small damage, and the barrage pins its victims in place instead of knocking them away. Higher levels hit harder and channel longer.
spell.jjk_spells.ground_smash.guide: Hop and drive a kick into the ground. A shockwave rolls out from the impact, hurting everything near the ground and throwing it away from you. Anything high in the air rides over the wave. Higher levels hit harder and widen the shockwave.
spell.jjk_spells.hard_strike.guide: Step into one heavy punch. Everything right in front of you takes big damage, is knocked away and is stunned for 1.4 seconds: unable to walk, jump, attack, cast or use items. Higher levels hit harder, reach farther and knock back more.
death.attack.jjk_spells.punch_barrage: %1$s was pummeled by %2$s's Barrage of Punches
death.attack.jjk_spells.hard_strike: %1$s was knocked out by %2$s's Hard Strike
spell.jjk_spells.moon_crescent_slash.gui: Swing your sword in one sweeping diagonal slash. A great purple crescent of force cuts everything in front of you, trailing a scatter of small blue crescent slashes. Deals a multiple of the damage of the weapon in your main hand.
spell.jjk_spells.moon_whirl.guide: Whip your sword around yourself so fast that a vortex of purple slashes, each wrapped in small blue crescents, spirals out and cuts everything around you again and again, ending with a blast that throws enemies away. Every cut deals a fraction of the damage of the weapon in your main hand.
spell.jjk_spells.moon_rainbow: Moon Breath, Sixteenth Form: Moon Rainbow - Half Moon
spell.jjk_spells.moon_rainbow.guide: Raise your sword and bring it down: the ground splits and tall curved purple slashes, each wrapped in blue crescents, burst out all around you, cutting upward through everything they pass and launching enemies into the air. Every slash deals a multiple of the damage of the weapon in your main hand.
death.attack.jjk_spells.moon_crescent_sl: %1$s was cut down by %2$s's Crescent Slash
death.attack.jjk_spells.moon_whirl: %1$s was shredded by %2$s's Heavenly Crescent Whirl
death.attack.jjk_spells.moon_rainbow: %1$s was sliced apart by %2$s's Moon Rainbow
spell.jjk_spells.tengai_shinsei.guide: Heavenly Star Falling. A colossal 40-block meteor is called down where you aim and crashes ten seconds later, its shockwave dealing 95 damage to everything it crosses. Three seconds on, a second meteor falls onto the first and the two detonate in a nuclear-style explosion that removes 40% of the max health of everything caught in it. The caster is spared.
spell.jjk_spells.crimson_ray: The Ruler of Death's Crimson Ray
spell.jjk_spells.crimson_ray.guide: A single vast crimson laser appears in the sky directly above you and fires down at wherever you aim (up to 110 blocks), following your aim for 9 seconds. It removes a percentage of max health from everything it touches, every tick.
spell.jjk_spells.death_wraiths.guide: Call up a host of hooded wraiths. They circle you, then each flies straight through the world at the creature you are looking at and removes 1.5% of its max health.
item.jjk_spells.gilgamesh_grimoire: Grimoire of the King of Heroes
spell.jjk_spells.sun_dance.guide: Lunge up to 12 blocks into your enemies, untouchable during the dash, then finish with a powerful downward slash that leaves a great curved arc of flame. Damage is based on the weapon in your hand.
spell.jjk_spells.sun_radiance: Sun Breathing: Seventh Form - Beneficent Radiance
spell.jjk_spells.sun_radiance.guide: Hold a thrust stance while a golden point gathers on your blade, then dash 12 blocks in an instant, piercing everything in the path and ending in a ring of sunlight and a shockwave. Damage is based on your weapon.
spell.jjk_spells.sun_setting: Sun Breathing: Ninth Form - Setting Sun Transformation
spell.jjk_spells.sun_setting.guide: Leap about 5 blocks up, flip backwards and bring a gigantic crescent of sunfire crashing to the ground. You take no fall damage. Damage is based on your weapon.
spell.jjk_spells.sun_eternal: Sun Breathing: Thirteenth Form - The Sun's Eternal Dance
spell.jjk_spells.sun_eternal.guide: Awaken: your blade ignites and nearby enemies are slowed. Then twelve consecutive attacks - Solar Slashes, Blazing Dance, Solar Cyclone, Crimson Flash and Final Sunrise - before a ring of fire sweeps outward for 50 extra damage. Damage is based on your weapon.
spell.jjk_spells.decimate.guide: Pull the axe back, bend your knees and sweep it through a full circle. Enemies caught by the outer blade take 500% of your weapon's damage; enemies too close, caught by the handle, take only 250%. Hitting at least one enemy with the outer blade restores 15% of your maximum health, once per cast.
spell.jjk_spells.crippling_strike.guide: Grip the axe in both hands and let the head glow dark crimson. For 4 seconds your next melee attack is a brutal chop: bonus damage equal to 500% of your weapon's damage, Slowness III for 3 seconds, heavy durability damage to shields, and the target staggers backward. Killing an ordinary enemy with it refunds half of the remaining cooldown.
spell.jjk_spells.apprehend.guide: Plant your feet and swing the axe in a broad dark-red crescent. Enemies in the arc (about 100 degrees, 10 blocks) take 25 damage, are outlined in red and dragged up to 6 blocks toward you, then slowed (Slowness II). Bosses and anything immovable are staggered and slowed instead of pulled.
spell.jjk_spells.noxian_guillotine.guide: Lock onto an enemy within 8 blocks and, after a one second wind-up, leap and bring the axe down in an execution strike worth 500% of your weapon's damage, 750% against targets below 30% health and 800% below 15%. Killing an ordinary enemy resets the cooldown instantly; any kill makes you roar.
spell.jjk_spells.dio_muda.guide: The World materializes behind you in a golden flash and throws 70 punches in 4 seconds at whatever you aim at (you can move your aim to switch targets, but you are Slowed III). Each punch deals 6 damage plus 0.25% of the target's max health; the final punch adds 60 damage and 1% max health and sends the target flying.
spell.jjk_spells.dio_beam.guide: Red energy gathers in your eyes, then two narrow crimson streams shoot out up to 20 blocks, piercing up to 4 enemies for 30 damage plus 5% of their max health.
spell.jjk_spells.dio_impact.guide: The World draws its fist back with spiralling golden energy, then lunges. The target takes 100 damage plus 10% of its max health; everyone else within 4 blocks of the impact takes 70.
spell.jjk_spells.dio_roller.guide: Lock onto an enemy within 8 blocks, who is held completely helpless (even with status immunity). The World lifts a road roller, you leap with it and it crashes down: 100 damage plus 10% max health in 11.5 blocks, then a crushing barrage (6 damage per hit, 15% max health in total) and a final blow of 100 plus 10% that launches everything away. Bosses take half of the crushing damage and cannot be killed by the final blow.
death.attack.jjk_spells.apprehend: %1$s was hooked and cut down by %2$s
spell.jjk_spells.decisive_strike.guide: Plant your feet, gather white-blue energy along your blade and lunge forward in a heavy diagonal slash for 500% of your weapon's damage. The target is stunned briefly, the strike clears slowness and other movement impairments from you, and your next melee hit lands with bonus damage.
spell.jjk_spells.judgment.guide: Spin with your sword held out, cutting every enemy within 4 blocks for 150% of your weapon's damage every half second. You move faster while spinning, and the spin ends with a heavy finishing slash and a ripple through the ground.
spell.jjk_spells.courage.guide: Brace behind your shield arm. For a few seconds incoming damage is cut by 60% (75% during the first half second, to reward good timing) and you cannot be knocked back. Blocked hits flash gold and ring like steel.
spell.jjk_spells.demacian_justice.guide: Mark the enemy you are looking at. A golden rune opens beneath them, the light dims, and a gigantic spectral sword crashes down in a pillar of gold and white light. The weaker the target, the harder it hits, ignoring damage caps.
spell.jjk_spells.summon_undead.guide: Raise your staff and a purple circle opens beneath you. Skeletal hands claw out of the ground and 7-10 skeleton soldiers in enchanted netherite gear rise to fight whatever you point them at. Each has 450 health and Speed I, and every hit withers its target.
spell.jjk_spells.cry_of_the_banshee.guid: A ring of spectral faces screams outward. Enemies take damage, are weakened and slowed, and are frightened: they cannot attack, target or cast for a moment.
spell.jjk_spells.black_hole.guide: Conjure a black sphere at the targeted spot. Enemies are dragged toward it for two seconds, then it collapses in a devastating implosion.
spell.jjk_spells.goal_of_all_life_is_dea: The Goal of All Life Is Death

After a short cast you must stand still for seven seconds while a vast crimson circle charges. The death wave then strips every enemy in range of half their maximum health for 80 seconds, and may kill the nearly dead outright. You gain Death Ascendance afterwards.
spell.jjk_spells.fallen_down.guide: A super-tier holy spell. After a short cast, stand still while a golden sphere gathers high above the target area, then crashes down for 40% of every enemy's maximum health.
spell.jjk_spells.reality_slash.guide: Cut a rift through reality in a straight line. Everything it passes through takes heavy damage that partly ignores armour and scales with max health.
spell.jjk_spells.black_goat_sacrifice.gu: A short cast, then a four second stand-still ritual. The Black Goat of the Woods emerges with several of its Young and rampages among your enemies for about a minute. They have 27 times the health, hit 9 times harder and run 1.4 times faster than normal, and while any of them lives you take 25% less damage.
spell.jjk_spells.grasp_heart.guide: Crush a target's heart from afar. If the target is below 10% health the heart is crushed outright and it dies. Against anything healthier it takes heavy damage and is stunned. After The Goal of All Life Is Death it can also kill boss-type creatures.
death.attack.jjk_spells.summon_undead: %1$s was cut down by the undead of %2$s
death.attack.jjk_spells.cry_of_the_bansh: %1$s was claimed by the Cry of the Banshee of %2$s
death.attack.jjk_spells.black_hole: %1$s was crushed by the Black Hole of %2$s
death.attack.jjk_spells.goal_of_all_life: %1$s learned that the goal of all life is death, thanks to %2$s
death.attack.jjk_spells.fallen_down: %1$s was struck down by the Fallen Down of %2$s
death.attack.jjk_spells.reality_slash: %1$s was cut out of reality by %2$s
death.attack.jjk_spells.black_goat_sacri: %1$s was trampled by the Black Goat of %2$s
spell.jjk_spells.blade_of_the_ruined_kin: Lower your stance and let the greatsword flare emerald, then dash 7 blocks forward (up to 12 to reach the enemy you are looking at), slashing through everything along the way. Each enemy struck takes 100 damage plus 4% of its maximum health and is slowed for 1.5 seconds. A ghostly green blade trail lingers behind the swing.
spell.jjk_spells.spectral_maw.guide: Gather the Black Mist around yourself for a second, then charge forward like a spectral beast, up to 10 blocks, while a spectral bolt flies ahead of you (60 damage plus 3% max health, piercing, up to 16 blocks). You crash into the first enemy in your path for 90 damage plus 4% of its maximum health and stun it for 2 seconds while mist tendrils wrap around it.
spell.jjk_spells.harrowed_path.guide: Release the Black Mist across 20 blocks for 15 seconds. Inside it you move 35% faster, turn invisible and your melee attacks hit twice as hard. Enemies inside are slowed by 20%, weakened (Weakness II) and lose 35% of their spell power for as long as they stay in the mist.
spell.jjk_spells.sovereigns_domination.g: Thrust your free hand at an enemy that has Weakness II or stronger and tear its soul from its body. The target loses 40% of its maximum health for 20 seconds; you restore 25% of your maximum health and gain +50% spell power for 100 seconds.
spell.jjk_spells.heartbreaker.guide: Dissolve into the Black Mist while a ghostly circle marks your target, then reform in mid-air above it and plunge down. The target takes 100 damage plus 12% of its maximum health; enemies within 4 blocks take 70 plus 7% and are knocked back. A target below 15% health is executed.
death.attack.jjk_spells.blade_of_the_rui: %1$s was cut down by %2$s's Blade of the Ruined King
spell.jjk_spells.jotaro_ora.guide: Star Platinum appears behind you in a flash of purple and steps forward, throwing 70 punches in 4 seconds at whatever you aim at: 6 damage plus 0.25% of the target's max health each (the percent ignores damage caps). The last punch adds 60 damage plus 1% max health and launches the target with a shockwave. You are slowed (Slowness III) while it barrages. Cooldown 10 seconds.
spell.jjk_spells.jotaro_star_finger.guid: Star Platinum appears beside you and its finger stretches out up to 20 blocks toward where you aim, in a thin trail of purple light that ends in a sharp flash. It pierces up to 4 enemies for 30 damage plus 5% of their max health each (the percent ignores damage caps). Cooldown 10 seconds.
spell.jjk_spells.jotaro_guard.guide: Star Platinum appears in front of you and blocks every attack aimed at you for 4 seconds, with no knockback. You cannot move or cast while guarding. Every blocked hit (including max-health percent damage) is stored. Then Star Platinum smashes the ground: 40% of the stored damage is dealt in full to every enemy within 5 blocks, and they are thrown outward hard. Cooldown 40 seconds.
spell.jjk_spells.jotaro_onslaught.guide: You and Star Platinum dash 16 blocks in about a fifth of a second. Up to 10 enemies in the path (3 blocks wide, 3 high) are frozen in place and outlined in purple, then, a moment after the dash ends, all of them suffer the 12 blows at once: 240 damage plus 10% of max health each (the percent ignores damage caps), and are thrown away from the path (bosses only stagger). Cooldown 35 seconds.
spell.jjk_spells.darkin_blade.guide: Pull the greatsword back over your shoulder and bring it down in a brutal overhead strike. A red fissure tears 6 blocks across the ground, 5 wide: everything in it takes 70 damage plus 5% of its maximum health and is knocked back and staggered; whatever is near the centre takes 200 plus 7% and is launched into the air.
spell.jjk_spells.infernal_chains.guide: Hurl a jagged mass of dark red energy up to 12 blocks. On a hit it deals 70 damage, irradiates the target for 20 seconds, slows it, and chains it to a cursed circle. If it is still inside the circle 1.5 seconds later, the chains drag it to the centre and stun it for 3 seconds.
spell.jjk_spells.umbral_dash.guide: Spread your wings and surge 5 blocks in a quarter of a second, in the direction you are moving. Enemies you pass through take 100 damage plus 4% of their maximum health. You resist knockback during the dash, and can use it to line up The Darkin Blade.
spell.jjk_spells.world_ender.guide: Roar and unleash your true Darkin form for 12 seconds: enormous crimson wings, a blood-red aura and a darkened world. +20% movement speed, +50% damage dealt, 20% of damage dealt is healed back (capped), and your sword attacks are 20% bigger.
spell.jjk_spells.oblivions_descent.guide: Pick a spot up to 16 blocks away. After a 1.5 second wind-up in which you rise and hover above it, wings spread, fold your wings and plunge down, driving the blade into the ground in a crimson shockwave 10 blocks wide: 280 damage plus 10% of maximum health to everything in it, thrown outward. No blocks are destroyed.
death.attack.jjk_spells.darkin_blade: %1$s was cleaved apart by %2$s's Darkin Blade
death.attack.jjk_spells.infernal_chains: %1$s was dragged down by %2$s's Infernal Chains
death.attack.jjk_spells.umbral_dash: %1$s was cut down by %2$s's Umbral Dash
spell.jjk_spells.true_dragon_ascension.g: Rise high into the air inside a vast golden circle. After three seconds a colossal beam of light erupts from the circle, and you gain True Dragon Authority for five minutes: +150% spell power, +200% attack damage, bonus melee damage based on the target's max health, immunity to negative effects and creative flight.
death.attack.jjk_spells.true_dragon_asce: %1$s was judged by the True Dragon of %2$s
spell.jjk_spells.guide_to_afterlife.guid: Twirl your weapon in a ring of burning butterflies. For 9 seconds you are faster and stronger, immune to ordinary fire, and every melee hit adds fire damage and plants Blood Blossom. Costs a share of your current health.
spell.jjk_spells.secret_spear_of_wangshe: Dash up to 14 blocks as a streak of crimson fire, piercing every enemy on the way. Marked enemies detonate their Blood Blossom, and the trail erupts in flames moments later.
spell.jjk_spells.spirit_soother.guide: Send a mischievous ghost to the target. It bursts in a crimson spirit explosion, then returns to you, healing you for every enemy it caught.
spell.jjk_spells.funeral_of_a_thousand_b: A seven second ceremony: a dance of twelve spear strikes, a gate to the afterlife that drags enemies in, and a giant ghost that cremates the battlefield in a storm of butterflies. Below 35% health it becomes the Crimson Funeral.
spell.jjk_spells.smouldering_fire.guide: Magma Fragment. Laevatain fuses five magma fragments into a homing molten projectile. On impact it shatters into fragments that each strike a different enemy, then they collapse into a final explosion. Hitting a target that is already burning triggers Molten Overload: a bigger explosion, extra damage and three more fragments.
spell.jjk_spells.seethe.guide: Eruption of the Scorched Earth. She plants her sword in the ground; glowing cracks race to the target area and eight magma pillars erupt, then the area detonates. Enemies that are already burning each get an extra pillar of their own (Chain Combustion).
spell.jjk_spells.sviga_laevi.guide: Blade of the Burning Horizon. A colossal spectral greatsword cleaves in a wide arc and flings a giant crescent of fire that pierces everything, then its path erupts. Enemies below 30% health take Molten Execution (extra damage, never an instant kill). She has Resistance III during the swing.
spell.jjk_spells.twilight_world_in_flame: Laevatain's ultimate. Sviga Lævi awakens above her, six great sword strikes tear the battlefield, magma pillars erupt, and a colossal overhead cleave detonates over 18 blocks, leaving the ground burning. She cannot be hurt while it plays. Below 40% health it becomes empowered (Scorching Heart).
death.attack.jjk_spells.smouldering_fire: %1$s was burned down by %2$s's Smouldering Fire
item.jjk_spells.ward_ring.guide: A curio ring that blunts max-health percentage damage by 6%.
item.jjk_spells.ward_amulet.guide: A curio amulet that blunts max-health percentage damage by 10%.
item.jjk_spells.ward_belt.guide: A curio belt that blunts max-health percentage damage by 6%.
item.jjk_spells.ward_bracelet.guide: A curio bracelet that blunts max-health percentage damage by 4%.
item.jjk_spells.ward_charm.guide: A curio charm that blunts max-health percentage damage by 4%. All lesser wards together stop at 40%.
spell.jjk_spells.gate_of_babylon: Gate of Babylon: The King's Treasury
spell.jjk_spells.gate_of_babylon.guide: Golden portals open behind you and fire a volley of legendary weapons. Then a great portal opens over your target and an ornamental sword falls: Royal Judgment. Stand still for King's Arrogance.
spell.jjk_spells.enkidu_chains_of_heaven: Chains of Heaven bind the creature you look at. Divine targets are held longer and take extra damage from Gilgamesh. Bosses are only slowed.
spell.jjk_spells.vimana.guide: Board the golden Vimana. Bombard the field, charge the Divine Cannon, then call a ring of spears.
spell.jjk_spells.merodach.guide: Draw Merodach and send a great golden slash. Struck enemies are marked; swords fall and detonate.
spell.jjk_spells.enuma_elish.guide: Ea awakens, rends space, and reality collapses around the impact. Killing a boss with it grants Supremacy.
spell.jjk_spells.kings_volley.guide: Golden portals open in an arc behind and around you, and a legendary weapon rotates into place in each. One after another they are fired at whoever you are looking at, leaving golden trails.
spell.jjk_spells.enkidu_chains.guide: Golden chains burst from the ground and spiral round the legs, torso and arms of the creature you are looking at, dragging it to the ground. It cannot move, attack or cast until the chains shatter.
spell.jjk_spells.kings_authority.guide: Your eyes flash crimson-gold and your body dissolves into golden fragments. You reappear where you were looking, through a small golden portal, and a ripple spreads out.
spell.jjk_spells.comet_spear.guide: Hold to charge, release to hurl a golden spear that pierces enemies. A tap hits three targets; a full charge (2s+) pierces everything, slows, ends in a shockwave, and deals 40% more to enemies below 20% health.
spell.jjk_spells.shield_vault.guide: Lock onto an enemy and vault at them behind the shield. The landing stuns and knocks neighbours back, then three spear strikes and a shield bash follow. A well-aimed vault is a Perfect Engagement: longer stun, faster strikes, extra shockwave.
spell.jjk_spells.aegis_storm.guide: Channel for 4s behind a raised shield: 95% frontal damage reduction, constant spear thrusts, knockback immunity. Blocked damage is stored and added to the final detonation. Below 30% health you block everything and cover a wider area.
spell.jjk_spells.starfall_execution: Starfall Execution: The Spear of War
spell.jjk_spells.starfall_execution.guid: Leap into the sky, hang for a moment, then dive onto the target area. Enemies at the spearpoint are stunned and set ablaze; five aftershocks and ground flames follow.
spell.jjk_spells.grand_starfall: Grand Starfall: The God Who Defied the Heavens
spell.jjk_spells.grand_starfall.guide: Ascend, call down a spear-shaped star and a six-spear phalanx, then collapse a dome of celestial fire onto the battlefield. The area burns, healing is cut and enemies are slowed. Afterwards you gain Mortal Will; five or more kills reduce the cooldown.
msg.jjk_spells.pantheon.refund: The heavens favour you: cooldown reduced
spell.jjk_spells.seismic_shard: Seismic Shard: Splinter of the Monolith
spell.jjk_spells.seismic_shard.guide: Tear a jagged stone from your own body and hurl it. It curves towards its target, shatters on impact, steals movement speed and breaks armor. Fragments scatter outward.
spell.jjk_spells.thunderclap.guide: Slam the ground to stagger and cripple everything nearby, send out an earthquake, then erupt in stone pillars. The earth stays fractured, slowing enemies and erupting beneath them.
spell.jjk_spells.brutal_strikes.guide: Reinforce your arms with granite and unleash three slow, devastating blows followed by a two-handed Titanic Smash. Each hit on the same enemy hits harder.
spell.jjk_spells.granite_shield: Granite Shield: Heart of the Mountain
spell.jjk_spells.granite_shield.guide: Cover yourself in granite: heavy damage reduction, no knockback, reflected damage. Stored force detonates when the shield ends. Cast again to release it early.
spell.jjk_spells.unstoppable_force.guide: Charge across the battlefield like a living mountain, crash down launching everything around you, unleash five seismic waves, then rise for a final judgment. The earth stays fractured, and you gain Monolith's Resilience.
spell.jjk_spells.predator.guide: Raise a slime sphere that swallows everything around your target, pulling enemies in, consuming them and compressing them into a final crushing blow. Weak enemies are devoured, you recover health and mana, and a kill hardens you for a few seconds.
spell.jjk_spells.black_lightning.guide: Gather a black sphere and release a bolt that paralyses its target, then arcs from enemy to enemy and finishes with a violent detonation. Lightning travels further and hits harder through water.
spell.jjk_spells.megiddo.guide: Mark an area and let lenses of water form in the sky. Beams of light pick off the weakest enemies, a focused judgment strikes the weakest of all, and a final rain falls on everyone inside. Strongest under a clear sky by day.
spell.jjk_spells.absolute_defense.guide: Wrap yourself in a golden barrier that negates the first attacks, blocks projectiles and returns them as bolts, and greatly reduces everything else. Cast it again, or let it end, to release all the damage it stored in one explosion.
spell.jjk_spells.spatial_domination.guid: Vanish and reappear right behind your target, send a dimensional slash through it, open four cracks around it and let the space collapse. A perfect position behind the target makes everything stronger.
spell.jjk_spells.beelzebuth.guide: Launch a black vortex that pulls in, suppresses and devours every soul around it. Weak enemies are consumed and many souls grant a harvest that empowers you and resets Predator.
spell.jjk_spells.imaginary_collapse.guid: Throw a sphere of void that impacts, drags everything into a gravity well, explodes twice and ruptures reality around it. Ignores part of armor and damage reduction.
spell.jjk_spells.void_god_azathoth: Void God Azathoth: End of Creation
spell.jjk_spells.void_god_azathoth.guide: Become the Void God: a black sun ruptures reality at the marked place, descends in a collapse, devours souls across the field and ends creation in one final compression. You are nearly invulnerable while casting and are blessed afterwards.
death.attack.jjk_spells.void_god_azathot: %1$s was undone by %2$s's Void God Azathoth
spell.jjk_spells.nether_apocalypse: Nether Apocalypse: Black Sun of Hell
spell.jjk_spells.nether_apocalypse.guide: A black sun rises over where you aim (up to 80 blocks), swells, snaps and falls: 180 + 15% max HP and a launch within 24 blocks. The Infernal Supernova (260 + 20% within 38) sets everything it hits on Eternal Hellfire, and Hell's Final Breath finishes burning enemies with +30%. You are 80% protected during the snap and impact.
spell.jjk_spells.primordial_dominion.gui: The world falls silent and a colossal shadow with burning red eyes stands over you. A shockwave, crushing pressure and a gaze that pushes everything into the ground hold the field for 7 seconds; ordinary mobs flee in terror. You take 75% less damage meanwhile.
spell.jjk_spells.dimensional_funeral.gui: Reality cracks open at the aimed point and a 60-block slash severs it: 220 + 18%, ignoring armor. Eight dimensional fractures follow, then everything within 30 blocks collapses inward for 280 + 22%. Struck enemies carry Dimensional Wounds.
spell.jjk_spells.absolute_negation: Absolute Negation: Law of the Primordial
spell.jjk_spells.absolute_negation.guide: Wrap yourself in the law of the primordial: 95% less damage for 10 seconds, the first five attacks negated, projectiles destroyed and answered with bolts, no knockback, stuns or fall damage. Cast again, or let it end, for a release that scales with the damage you prevented.
spell.jjk_spells.despair_time.guide: A clock of despair opens over the aimed point, chains of time bind everyone within 30 blocks, then the clock stops and the whole domain collapses. Time spent inside makes the collapse hurt more.
spell.jjk_spells.temptation_world.guide: A black-red kingdom closes around the aimed point. Inside it your power grows and your enemies crawl. Twelve demonic spears fall, then the world collapses; the weak are executed.
spell.jjk_spells.abyssal_genesis.guide: Seven black stars are born over the aimed point and rise into a false night. They fall on seven enemies, a supernova follows and the cosmos collapses in a great ring. Five struck enemies make it a catastrophe.
Diablo's ultimate. For twenty seconds you become the primordial black: a throne, an extinction star, a first judgment, a shattering of dimensions, a devouring of souls and the Absolute Extinction. Afterwards you hold True Authority.
death.attack.jjk_spells.temptation_king_: %1$s was erased by %2$s's Temptation King Azazel
spell.jjk_spells.world_devouring_abyss: World-Devouring Abyss: Predator of the World
spell.jjk_spells.world_devouring_abyss.g: A living abyss of slime opens where you aim (up to 70 blocks). It crushes everything within 25 blocks (180 + 15% max HP, then 35/s while pulling enemies in and weakening them), absorbs hostile projectiles to feed the final collapse (300 + 25%, +10 per projectile up to +200) and devours ordinary mobs below 15% health, restoring 5% max health and mana per kill (max 30%).
spell.jjk_spells.civilization_storm.guid: Black storm clouds gather over the aimed point (up to 85 blocks). The first bolt (200 + 18%) paralyses everything within 20 blocks; 75-damage strikes rain across 40 blocks while you take half damage, and the final pillar (320 + 25%, +30% on weakened enemies) ends it. Enemies in water take +25% lightning damage.
spell.jjk_spells.heavenly_execution_arra: Requires open sky (configurable). Water lenses fill the sky above the target (up to 110 blocks): thin solar beams of 120, then concentrated armor-piercing beams (300 + 25%, +35% on weakened enemies) on different enemies, and finally every lens converges for 280 + 22% within 50 blocks.
spell.jjk_spells.absolute_law_of_protect: For 12 seconds you take 95% less damage, the first 6 hits are fully negated, you cannot be knocked back, stunned or hurt by falls, and hostile projectiles are destroyed and answered by 90-damage bolts. The Rejection Release (300 + 25% within 35 blocks, +30 per 100 damage prevented, max +400) fires when you cast again or when it ends.
spell.jjk_spells.fracture_of_infinite_wo: Fracture of Infinite Worlds: Spatial Domination

You step through a portal and reappear before the target (up to 85 blocks). A 75-block slash (240 + 20%) opens Dimensional Wounds (+25% damage taken, -40% healing, no teleporting), eight spatial fractures (85 each) follow and the collapse (350 + 28%, +35% on weakened enemies) hits 40 blocks. Ignores 40% armor and 30% damage reduction.
spell.jjk_spells.abyss_that_consumes_all: A black vortex opens above the aimed point (up to 90 blocks): 220 + 18%, then 50/s while everything is dragged in and weakened by 75%. The collapse (420 + 35%, 50 blocks) leaves Soul Fracture (+30% damage taken, -50% healing). Ordinary mobs below 15% health are devoured, each restoring 6% max health and mana (max 36%).
spell.jjk_spells.birth_of_nothingness.gu: A star of nothingness falls on the aimed point (up to 110 blocks): impact 250 + 20%, then a supernova of 420 + 35% within 40 blocks that leaves Nihility Fracture. Space folds inward within 45 blocks and the final Birth of Nothingness (350 + 30%, +40% on weakened enemies, 65 blocks) ends it. Ignores 45% armor and 35% damage reduction.
spell.jjk_spells.end_of_all_creation: End of All Creation: Void God Azathoth
spell.jjk_spells.end_of_all_creation.gui: For 22 seconds your surroundings become an artificial universe (80 blocks). Judgment (350 + 30%) marks enemies with Void Extinction, destruction (500 + 40%), Soul Consumption (400 + 35%, pulls enemies in) and the final Annihilation (750 + 60%, +40% on bosses, 100 blocks). The last 12 seconds you take 95% less damage but cannot move. Afterwards the Chaos Creator's Blessing lasts 25 seconds; defeat 5 or more enemies and the blessing is extended, you heal and your cooldowns reset.
spell.jjk_spells.storm_dragons_wrath: Storm Dragon's Wrath: The Heavensplitting Tempest
spell.jjk_spells.storm_dragons_wrath.gui: Veldora raises his arms and black thunderclouds gather over where you aim (up to 90 blocks). A colossal tornado descends: 200 + 18% max HP within 35 blocks, then 45/s while enemies are dragged in, lifted and weakened (-60% speed, -35% damage). The storm collapses within 55 blocks for 350 + 28% (+30% on enemies below 30% health). Enemies in water take +25% lightning damage. You take 70% less damage and cannot be knocked back.
spell.jjk_spells.black_thunder_apocalyps: Black Thunder Apocalypse: Judgment of the Storm Dragon

A black thunderstorm opens over the aimed point (up to 100 blocks). The first bolt (250 + 20% within 25 blocks) paralyses (-60% speed, -50% attack speed, 6s); black bolts of 90 rain across 40 blocks while you take 75% less damage; the divine thunder (400 + 32% within 60 blocks, +35% below 30% health) ends it. Enemies in water take +30% lightning damage.
spell.jjk_spells.dragon_breath.guide: A true dragon breath tears along your line of sight (up to 120 blocks, 12 wide): 300 + 25% and Draconic Overload (+30% damage taken, -50% healing, 8s), then 60/s to everything inside. The endpoint detonates within 45 blocks for 380 + 30% (+35% below 30% health). Ignores 45% armor and 35% damage reduction; you take 85% less damage while breathing.
spell.jjk_spells.storm_dragons_fist: Storm Dragon's Fist: The Martial Art That Breaks Reality
spell.jjk_spells.storm_dragons_fist.guid: You vanish in lightning and reappear at the target (up to 60 blocks): 220 + 18% within 20 blocks, then eight lightning-fast strikes of 75. Every strike that lands adds 4% (max 32%) to the final dragon fist: 350 + 28% within 40 blocks, ignoring 40% armor. Enemies hit four times are paralysed. You take 80% less damage and cannot be slowed.
spell.jjk_spells.law_of_impossible_fate: Chaos King Nyarlathotep: Law of Impossible Fate
A probability domain of 40 blocks opens at the aimed point (up to 85 blocks) for 12 seconds. Enemies inside are slowed, deal less damage and heal less. Inside it you take 50% less damage, 40% of attacks against you miss, 25% of your attacks deal +50% and 35% of hostile projectiles are redirected. Twelve impossible strikes (100 each) hit the battlefield, then the domain collapses for 420 + 35% (+35% below 30% health).
spell.jjk_spells.storm_dragons_ascension: Storm Dragon's Ascension: The Calamity Incarnate

Veldora becomes the Storm Dragon: wings unfold and a shockwave hits 35 blocks for 250 + 20%. For 20 seconds: +60% damage, +40% speed, 70% less damage, no knockback, +120 melee damage, every third melee hit releases a lightning shockwave (10 blocks, 120 + 10%), projectiles deal 85% less damage. Defeat 3 enemies for +5s and +15% damage. When it ends the dragon detonates within 50 blocks for 480 + 38%.
spell.jjk_spells.dragon_nova: Dragon Nova: The Star That Drowns the Sky
spell.jjk_spells.dragon_nova.guide: A star of storm dragon energy forms, rises, swells and falls on the aimed point (up to 110 blocks): 280 + 22% within 35 blocks, then a supernova of 450 + 35% within 45 that pulls enemies in and leaves Storm Fracture (+30% damage taken, -50% healing, 10s). The star collapses within 70 blocks for 380 + 30% (+40% below 30% health). Ignores 45% armor and 35% damage reduction.
spell.jjk_spells.end_of_the_eternal_stor: Chaos King Nyarlathotep: The End of the Eternal Storm

An eternal storm dimension (85 blocks) opens at the aimed point (up to 140 blocks) for 22 seconds and a colossal spectral dragon rises. Thunder judgment 400 + 32% (Chaos Extinction Mark: +30% damage taken, -60% healing), dragon annihilation 550 + 45%, probability collapse 450 + 38%, and the final cataclysm within 105 blocks: 800 + 65% (+40% against bosses). Ignores 55% armor and 45% damage reduction. Probability Domination all along; the last 12 seconds you take 95% less damage but cannot move. Afterwards True Dragon's Blessing for 25s; defeat 5 or more enemies to reset Dragon Nova, halve the Law of Impossible Fate cooldown, heal 50% and extend the blessing.
death.attack.jjk_spells.storm_dragons_wr: %1$s was swept away by %2$s's Storm Dragon
spell.jjk_spells.scorch_dragons_breath.g: Velgrynd raises her hand and a stellar beam of crimson fire tears across the horizon, locking and detonating at its end. Absolute Scorch burns for seconds, cannot be put out and cuts healing.
spell.jjk_spells.cardinal_inferno: Cardinal Inferno: Seven Suns of Extinction
spell.jjk_spells.cardinal_inferno.guide: Seven miniature suns fall over the aimed area, branding everything they touch, then converge and burst in a supernova.
spell.jjk_spells.cardinal_acceleration.g: Velgrynd vanishes and strikes the target at light speed in a storm of precise blows, then falls from above for a final strike.
spell.jjk_spells.scorch_dragons_dominion: Scorch Dragon's Dominion: A World Without Cold
A scorching domain surrounds the caster: pillars of white fire, weakened and slowed enemies, empowered spells.
spell.jjk_spells.parallel_existence.guid: Four parallel Velgrynds surround the target and fire converging beams, caging it in fire before a final judgment.
spell.jjk_spells.dimensional_scorch: Dimensional Scorch: Flame That Hunts Eternity
spell.jjk_spells.dimensional_scorch.guid: The marked target is hunted through dimensional portals by accelerating strikes of fire, ending in a devastating final blow.
spell.jjk_spells.cardinal_cataclysm: Cardinal Cataclysm: Death of a Thousand Stars
spell.jjk_spells.cardinal_cataclysm.guid: A thousand stars fall on the aimed point, compress into a supernova that overheats everything left standing, then collapse in a final burst.
spell.jjk_spells.flame_god_cthugha: Flame God Cthugha: The Final Scorching of Creation
spell.jjk_spells.flame_god_cthugha.guide: The ultimate: a stellar domain of absolute flame judges, annihilates and collapses everything within it, leaving the caster crowned with Cardinal Sovereignty.
spell.jjk_spells.kaisers_impact.guide: Zegion vanishes and reappears in front of the target with a punch that shatters space. Shockwaves of broken air and a collapsing dimensional rupture follow.
spell.jjk_spells.mist_lords_domain.guide: A domain of violet mist with a false sky, giant mirrors and twelve spectral Kaisers that strike from every side, ending in a collapse of the fabricated reality.
spell.jjk_spells.obsidian_kaiser.guide: An exoskeleton of obsidian crystal negates the first attacks, stops almost everything after that, throws back projectiles and releases the stored force as a ground-shattering punch.
spell.jjk_spells.phantom_kaiser.guide: Zegion disappears behind dozens of afterimages and executes the target with a flurry of blinking strikes, a dimensional drop and a chain detonation of phantoms.
spell.jjk_spells.mephistos_labyrinth.gui: Mephisto's mirrored labyrinth imprisons enemies, cuts them with dimensional blades and closes into a sphere that collapses in a devastating explosion.
spell.jjk_spells.void_carapace.guide: A black singularity is thrown into the battlefield, drags enemies inward, devours them and folds into a point before detonating in a void explosion.
spell.jjk_spells.kaisers_final_form.guid: Crystal armor and gigantic energy wings. Zegion becomes a close-range sovereign whose strikes shatter space, until the wings fold and a final detonation erupts.
The ultimate: an artificial dimension, twelve giant spectral Kaisers, four judgments and a celestial sphere, ended by the annihilation of the fabricated world.
spell.jjk_spells.shadows_garden.guide: You vanish and cut through up to six enemies, but the cuts only store their damage. One last line is drawn through the target; when the sword is sheathed, everything lands at once.
spell.jjk_spells.nameless_king: The Nameless King: Throne of False Shadows
spell.jjk_spells.nameless_king.guide: A gothic throne rises and five false shadows stand around it. Whoever attacks them, or you, is answered from behind. Then the King's Judgment falls on the strongest enemy.
spell.jjk_spells.slime_armament.guide: A liquid-metal serpent rises, drives down as a spear, circles with tendrils, then coils around the strongest enemy and crushes it.
spell.jjk_spells.perfect_counter.guide: You lower the sword and wait. Every attack is caught and answered with a single counter; strike in the last second and it is perfect, interrupting the attacker.
spell.jjk_spells.i_am_atomic: I Am Atomic: The Purple Horizon
spell.jjk_spells.i_am_atomic.guide: Violet magic gathers on Shadow and his ebony sword. One stroke releases a torrent of blue-violet light that consumes the target and lights the whole horizon, then silence.
spell.jjk_spells.void_blue.guide: Lapse Blue unbound. A black hole of blue follows your aim, held eight blocks ahead, and drags in everything near it with brutal force. Anything caught inside cannot attack or cast spells. Requires Lapse: Blue scroll to learn.
spell.jjk_spells.heavenly_red.guide: Reversal Red at the scale of a catastrophe. A beam of repulsion strong enough to wipe out a mountain, dealing 200 + 10% of max health. Requires Reversal: Red scroll to learn.
spell.jjk_spells.divine_purple.guide: Hollow Purple, faster and larger, so quick it looks like a laser. Everything in its path is slowed (Slowness VI) when it is cast, then erased for 40% of max health. Requires Hollow Purple scroll to learn.
spell.jjk_spells.heavenly_onslaught.guid: Unlimited Void and Nine Ropes as one. A vast domain for 12 seconds; at the 7th second the caster charges every creature inside, tearing off heads and impaling survivors for 200 + 15% max health (survivors lose 15% max health for 16s). Then the caster returns to the centre and detonates a Purple that takes the domain and the land around it, for 50% max health. Requires Unlimited Void and Hollow Purple: Nine Ropes scrolls to learn.
spell.jjk_spells.yhwach_heiliger_pfeil.g: Yhwach's Quincy holy arrow: a giant Reishi bow forms, the arrow charges for 1.2 seconds and is loosed as a laser that detonates on contact.
spell.jjk_spells.boundless_slash.guide: A diagonal crescent of black and white, 20 blocks tall, cuts across the world. It is thin and hard to aim, but whatever it touches takes 150 + 10% of max health and is Dismantled: it cannot melee attack for 6 seconds.
spell.jjk_spells.world_disintegration.gu: Fuga unmade. A dark red flame arrow wrapped in purple fire charges for 2 seconds, then flies as a laser that distorts reality along its path. Where it lands, a pillar of dark red fire rises to the heavens: radius 30, 200 + 40% of max health. Requires the Fuga scroll to learn.
spell.jjk_spells.universe_severing_slash: The World Cutting Slash as a projectile of cosmic cuts. At the end of its path every cut condenses into a small black hole. Two seconds later it explodes and throws the slashes in all directions; each deals damage and Dismantles. Requires the World Cutting Slash scroll to learn.
spell.jjk_spells.yhwach_qual_kreis.guide: Twelve Reishi bows form a ring above you and rain arrows on your aim point for 7 seconds.
spell.jjk_spells.yhwach_kirchenlied_sank: A monumental Quincy sanctuary rises around you: eight pillars, arches and ritual rings. Enemies inside are struck by golden-white counterattacks from the pillars.
spell.jjk_spells.yhwach_vollstreckung.gu: A colossal Reishi sword hangs above your target and tracks it for 4 seconds, then falls: the target loses 50% of its max health for 30 seconds. Bosses take 12% max health damage and lose 12% max HP resistance instead.
spell.jjk_spells.yhwach_auswaehlen.guide: The sky fills with a colossal golden Quincy insignia. Up to 12 enemies within 70 blocks are marked and struck by pillars of light, their power drains into a giant halo behind you, and the halo collapses into you for a final reclamation.
spell.jjk_spells.gamma_ray_burst.guide: Garou's Cosmic Fear Mode finisher. You stop, a miniature dark cosmic sphere forms between your hands and collapses; two enormous white-blue beams burst out of it and merge into one catastrophic beam that erases everything ahead.
spell.jjk_spells.yhwach_the_almighty.gui: Darkness consumes a 35-block circle around you: it drains and blinds enemies, devours the dead to heal you, raises eyed pillars that fire black lasers, and caps the damage you can take. Afterwards it gathers into an orb and releases a giant beam.
spell.jjk_spells.vergil_judgement_cut_en: Vergil's dimensional slash. Sheathe, draw: space around your aim point is carved into a cage of blue lines. Enemies inside are rooted, cut eight times, and the space then shatters like glass for a final heavy hit.
spell.jjk_spells.nuclear_fission.guide: Garou's cosmic fist: gather cosmic energy, launch forward and punch. The impact detonates as a nuclear explosion.
spell.jjk_spells.vergil_spiral_swords.gu: Forty-eight giant spectral swords ring your aim point and spiral inward, dragging enemies to the centre. Six volleys pin everything in the zone, then every sword bursts in a final shatter.
spell.jjk_spells.vergil_dimension_rush.g: Blink up to 64 blocks along your aim line. The space along the path is cut into a 24 block wide corridor: enemies inside are rooted, sliced six times, and once you sheathe the blade the corridor shatters like glass.
spell.jjk_spells.vergil_devil_trigger.gu: A huge spectral demon rises behind you for 15 seconds. You gain Speed, Strength, Regeneration, +25% max HP damage and +15% max HP resistance, while phantom slashes keep cutting enemies within 30 blocks. When the form ends it bursts in a shockwave.
spell.jjk_spells.vergil_helm_breaker.gui: Leap into the sky and slam down on your aim point. The ground splits into dimensional fissures across 25 blocks, cutting everything inside for 3 seconds before slamming shut in a final shatter.
spell.jjk_spells.vergil_crescent_wave.gu: Draw the blade: a colossal crescent of cut space, 40 blocks wide, sweeps 84 blocks forward and cuts everything it crosses. Each cut is marked and catches up to the victim a moment later for a second slice.
Vergil's ultimate. One slash cuts the world: a 50 block cage of cut space closes around your target area, the sky cracks and darkens like glass, enemies are dragged to the centre while eight sheets of falling sky rain down, a rift opens, and finally the whole sky shatters.
spell.jjk_spells.garou_gamma_ray_burst.g: Garou recreates the cosmic phenomenon: a dark sphere forms between his hands, compresses, and two beams merge into one catastrophic beam. You cannot move while it fires.
spell.jjk_spells.garou_gravity_knuckle.g: Garou wraps his fist in a gravity sphere, dashes at the target and punches. A gravitational well drags every enemy within 30 blocks to the impact for 1.5 seconds, then collapses with heavy damage and knockback.
spell.jjk_spells.garou_cosmic_portal.gui: Garou opens Blast's portal and steps through. Look at an enemy to come out behind it with a punch, or look at a spot (up to 30 blocks) to simply reposition.
Garou's cosmic body radiates a deadly invisible tide. For 25 seconds every enemy within 8 blocks is irradiated: they take 35 damage plus 2% of their maximum health every 2 seconds, move 15% slower and receive 20% less healing. Radiation clings for up to 10 seconds after an enemy leaves the aura. Never harms you or your allies.
spell.jjk_spells.frieren_zoltraak.guide: Frieren's standard offensive magic. A small formation opens at your raised hand and a thick white-blue laser is fired almost instantly down your line of sight (45 blocks), piercing every enemy in its path.
spell.jjk_spells.frieren_defensive_magic: Frieren's modern defensive magic. A seal opens before you and a hexagon-panelled barrier unfolds round you. Allies inside take 80% less damage until it has absorbed 1500 damage; if it breaks, it bursts in a defensive pulse that hurts nearby enemies.
spell.jjk_spells.frieren_flammes_ultimat: An ancient technique of Flamme's teaching. A great circle opens beneath you, circles gather in the sky and a sphere of light forms above the target (range 40). Five blue-white lances fall over a 29 block area in rapid succession, each striking for 100 damage plus 4% maximum health in an 8 block blast. The final lance detonates across the whole area for 250 damage plus 10% maximum health. Never harms you or your allies.
spell.jjk_spells.frieren_vollzanbel.guid: A massive, concentrated inferno. A red circle opens before you and for 7 seconds you pour an enormous torrent of flame wherever you aim (range 45); everything caught in it burns for 45 damage plus 2% maximum health every second. Then the flames collapse into a single point and detonate across 35 blocks for 320 damage plus 15% maximum health. Never harms you or your allies.
spell.jjk_spells.all_life_eradication_fi: Garou's ultimate cosmic martial art: a stance, five rapid strikes, nuclear fission, a gravity collapse and a final cosmic shockwave.
spell.jjk_spells.yone_twin_crescents.gui: Yone cuts three times with his two blades: a blue Mortal Steel stroke, a red Spirit Blade stroke, then both together in a cross. Every stroke sends a crescent of cut air flying forward through everything in its way.
spell.jjk_spells.yone_spirit_cleave: Spirit Cleave: Veil of Two Blades
spell.jjk_spells.yone_spirit_cleave.guid: Yone crosses both blades, then tears them apart in a wide sweep that fans crescents across the cone before him. The blades close again in a scissor cut that drags survivors in. Every enemy caught feeds a shield, and the two blades circle him as a veil while it lasts.
spell.jjk_spells.yone_ghost_walk.guide: Yone's spirit steps out of his body and rushes ahead, steered by his aim, cutting and marking everything it passes while the body stands untouchable. When the spirit snaps back, every marked enemy is torn to him and ripped, and the return shatters the air around him.
spell.jjk_spells.yone_fate_sealed.guide: Yone draws a line across the world and dashes along it in one breath, cutting every enemy on it and flinging them into the air. They hang sealed on the line until he severs the line itself in one final stroke.
spell.jjk_spells.yone_horned_volley.guid: An Oni mask rises over Yone and spectral swords slide from its mouth into a pair of horns, blue on the left and red on the right. One after another they fly at his enemies and stay buried in them, and when the volley ends every buried sword explodes.
A blue moon and a red moon rise over the spot Yone points at and slide together into an eclipse. Everything beneath is dragged into a funnel, and when the moons align a giant X of blue and red blades falls through the middle and splits the realm.
spell.jjk_spells.yone_destiny_cleaved.gu: Yone and his spirit split apart and cross two giant slashes over a huge area. Everything caught is frozen, cut twice, then cleaved along the crossing.
spell.jjk_spells.yasuo_steel_tempest.gui: Yasuo thrusts twice in a flash, lunging forward each time. The third thrust gathers the wind into a towering tornado that sweeps ahead, lifting every enemy it touches off the ground and shredding them.
spell.jjk_spells.yasuo_wind_wall.guide: Yasuo sweeps his hand and a colossal wall of wind rises before him. For seven seconds it tears apart every hostile projectile that touches it, and shoves back and cuts any enemy that dares to cross.
spell.jjk_spells.yasuo_sweeping_blade.gu: Yasuo vanishes in a gust and chain-dashes through the enemies around him, cutting each one and leaving blue afterimages in his wake. With nobody near, he simply dashes ahead.
spell.jjk_spells.yasuo_windbound_duel.gu: A ring of wind closes around the enemy Yasuo faces. No one else may enter, the chosen foe cannot leave, and every blow Yasuo lands on him bites harder while the wind cuts him each second.
spell.jjk_spells.yasuo_last_breath.guide: A gust lifts every enemy around Yasuo into the air and holds them there. He blinks from one to the next cutting each, a doppelganger left at every cut, then the mark detonates and slams them all back down.
spell.jjk_spells.yasuo_reaping_cyclone.g: Yasuo spins his blade and a vast cyclone follows him, dragging every enemy into its spiral and slicing them over and over. The last turn harvests them all and hurls them skyward.
spell.jjk_spells.yasuo_thousand_winds.gu: Yasuo plants himself and spectral doppelgangers ring the field. Giant blades of wind rain across a vast area, hunting his enemies, until every blade converges in one last cut that levels the arena.
spell.jjk_spells.dante_million_stab.guid: Dante's Stinger: a lunge that skewers and carries everything in his path, then fourteen lightning fast stabs on whatever is left around him, and finally a colossal Rebellion plunges from the sky and detonates.
spell.jjk_spells.dante_stylish_rank.guid: The style meter of a devil hunter. Every Dante spell raises the rank from D towards SSS. At S a timer starts: when it ends a bullet hell engulfs the caster, bigger at SS, or a massive Hellfire Slash tears through everything ahead at SSS.
spell.jjk_spells.dante_royal_guard.guide: Dante raises the Royal Guard. For a few seconds every blow is absorbed and stored, then the stored power is released in a colossal shockwave. Cast again to release early.
spell.jjk_spells.dante_cavaliere_ride.gu: Dante summons the Cavaliere, a motorcycle of pure lightning, and rides it wherever he looks, ramming and shocking everything near. When the ride ends a thunderstorm crashes down, finished by one colossal bolt.
spell.jjk_spells.dante_devil_trigger.gui: Dante awakens the devil blood of Sparda. A crimson shockwave tears out, flame wings unfold and a burning aura wraps him, making him stronger, tougher and faster, while a Devil Burst blasts the area every few seconds.
spell.jjk_spells.dante_round_trip.guide: Dante hurls two giant spinning Rebellions that loop out in mirrored arcs, dragging in and shredding everything on the way, slam together at the far end, then return to him and burst into a ring of blades.
spell.jjk_spells.dante_sparda_judgment: Sin Devil Trigger: Judgment of Sparda
spell.jjk_spells.dante_sparda_judgment.g: Dante ascends in his Sin Devil Trigger form. A heptagram of hellfire spreads over the battlefield, every enemy is locked on and a rain of giant Rebellions crashes down on them, before Dante dives into the centre and passes final judgment.
spell.jjk_spells.frieren_ancient_release: Frieren unleashes an overwhelming amount of mana. Stand still for four seconds while a vast seal forms and a sphere of magic compresses into a single point, then fire a colossal Zoltraak that burns for three seconds and ends in a giant explosion.
spell.jjk_spells.frieren_height_of_magic: Frieren's ultimate offensive magic. Over four seconds a vast seal opens beneath you and a miniature star gathers overhead. Release it and the star fires a beam at your target; the impact explodes outward across 50 blocks, striking every enemy it reaches.
